description.value: Suzette's Deli is a weekday breakfast and lunch spot tucked into a Burnaby business park, known for fresh, natural ingredients across a broad menu of bagels, wraps, sandwiches, soups, and pastries. Under newer ownership with a revamped menu, it caters heavily to the local office crowd and offers full catering services for group orders. A touring cyclist passing through the Henning Drive corridor would find solid takeout options and a wide selection of handheld, portable fare.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 31m; stands (8 spaces) at 67m; stands (4 spaces) at 81m. Total: 16 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Suzette's Deli is an active cafe/deli at #116-3993 Henning Dr., Burnaby with matching phone number, serving breakfast and lunch with takeout explicitly mentioned. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities on the website or in OSM tags (outdoor_seating=no confirmed by OSM). The business appears open and operational based on consistent website content and contact details.
